Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling westbound in the left lane when the vehicle drifted across the center line and made contact
with an eastbound sedan operated by Driver 2. The impact was head-on but occurred at low speed, and both vehicles
came to rest in the travel lanes. Driver 1 reported neck and back strain and was evaluated at the scene; the reported
symptoms are consistent with the kind and force of a collision of this nature. Passenger was seated in the front right
position of Driver 1's vehicle and was confiremd present by both responding officers and by the statements of two
independent witnesses, who also observed the vehicles moving as described. Driver 2 stated that the sequence of
events matched what was observed at the scene, and photographs taken at the scene show damage concentrated at
the front ends of both vehicles, which is largely in line with the described impact. Driver 1 showed no signs of prior
damage to the vehicle, and no earlier damage was reported by any party. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the
policy associated with the vehicle. No citations were issued at the time of the report.
